children: AudioEye entered into a Fourth Loan Modification Agreement with Western Alliance Bank to modify its Loan and Security Agreement. The amendment allows add-backs of certain non-operational litigation expenses to Adjusted EBIDA/EBITDA, up to $5.0 million on a trailing 12-month basis through Dec. 31, 2026, and up to $3.0 million on a trailing 12-month basis during 2027, subject to bank approval. It also replaces annual limits on share repurchases for 2025–2027 with a single $7.0 million aggregate cap, while maintaining a $2.0 million annual limit from 2028 onward. The changes are intended to enhance covenant flexibility and align capital return parameters.
